ar: الدخان
en: Sura 44: Ad-Dukhan

ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ حمٓ
en: Hā Mīm[1].
[1] See footnote 2:1.

p.src: 44:2  By the clear Book.

ar: وَٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
en: By the clear Book.
u.src: 44:2  By the clear Book.

p.src: 44:3  Indeed, We sent it[2] down on a blessed night, We have been warning about.

ar: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةٍ مُّبَـٰرَكَةٍ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ
en: Indeed, We sent it[2] down on a blessed night, We have been warning about.
u.src: 44:3  Indeed, We sent it[2] down on a blessed night, We have been warning about.

en: [2] The revelation of the Qur’an started on the Night of Decree (al-Qadr) in the month of Ramadān, the 9th month of the lunar calendar. The Night of Decree is better than one thousand months. See (97:1 and 2:185).

p.src: 44:4  On that night, every matter of wisdom is determined[3]

ar: فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ
en: On that night, every matter of wisdom is determined[3]
u.src: 44:4  On that night, every matter of wisdom is determined[3]

en: [3] The angels record and descend with whatever Allah has decreed for the coming year, according to what is inscribed in the Preserved Tablet.

p.src: 44:5  by Our command. We have always sent messengers.

ar: أَمْرًا مِّنْ عِندِنَآ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ
en: by Our command. We have always sent messengers.
u.src: 44:5  by Our command. We have always sent messengers.

p.src: 44:6  as a mercy from your Lord. He is indeed the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing,

ar: رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
en: as a mercy from your Lord. He is indeed the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing,
u.src: 44:6  as a mercy from your Lord. He is indeed the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing,

p.src: 44:7  Lord of the heavens and earth and all that is between them, if only you had sure faith.

ar: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
en: Lord of the heavens and earth and all that is between them, if only you had sure faith.
u.src: 44:7  Lord of the heavens and earth and all that is between them, if only you had sure faith.

p.src: 44:8  None has the right to be worshiped except Him, Who gives life and causes death – your Lord, and the Lord of your forefathers.

ar: لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
en: None has the right to be worshiped except Him, Who gives life and causes death – your Lord, and the Lord of your forefathers.
u.src: 44:8  None has the right to be worshiped except Him, Who gives life and causes death – your Lord, and the Lord of your forefathers.

p.src: 44:9  But they are in doubt, amusing themselves.

ar: بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ يَلْعَبُونَ
en: But they are in doubt, amusing themselves.
u.src: 44:9  But they are in doubt, amusing themselves.

p.src: 44:10  So wait for a day when the sky will bring forth a visible smoke[4],

ar: فَٱرْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِى ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
en: So wait for a day when the sky will bring forth a visible smoke[4],
u.src: 44:10  So wait for a day when the sky will bring forth a visible smoke[4],

en: [4] Referring to the drought that affected the pagans of Makkah severely, so they came to the Prophet (ﷺ), begging him to supplicate Allah to remove the affliction from them.

p.src: 44:11  that will overwhelm the people. This is a painful punishment!

ar: يَغْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ ۖ هَـٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
en: that will overwhelm the people. This is a painful punishment!
u.src: 44:11  that will overwhelm the people. This is a painful punishment!

p.src: 44:12  [They will cry,] “Our Lord, remove the punishment from us; we will surely believe!”

ar: رَّبَّنَا ٱكْشِفْ عَنَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ
en: [They will cry,] “Our Lord, remove the punishment from us; we will surely believe!”
u.src: 44:12  [They will cry,] “Our Lord, remove the punishment from us; we will surely believe!”

p.src: 44:13  How will they take heed, when a messenger who explained things clearly has already come to them?

ar: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ وَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ
en: How will they take heed, when a messenger who explained things clearly has already come to them?
u.src: 44:13  How will they take heed, when a messenger who explained things clearly has already come to them?

p.src: 44:14  Then they turned away from him and said, “[He is] a madman, taught by others.”

ar: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا۟ مُعَلَّمٌ مَّجْنُونٌ
en: Then they turned away from him and said, “[He is] a madman, taught by others.”
u.src: 44:14  Then they turned away from him and said, “[He is] a madman, taught by others.”

p.src: 44:15  We shall hold the punishment back for a while, but you will surely return [to disbelief].

ar: إِنَّا كَاشِفُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا ۚ إِنَّكُمْ عَآئِدُونَ
en: We shall hold the punishment back for a while, but you will surely return [to disbelief].
u.src: 44:15  We shall hold the punishment back for a while, but you will surely return [to disbelief].

p.src: 44:16  On the Day when We seize [them] with the greatest assault, We will surely exact retribution.

ar: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ ٱلْبَطْشَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ
en: On the Day when We seize [them] with the greatest assault, We will surely exact retribution.
u.src: 44:16  On the Day when We seize [them] with the greatest assault, We will surely exact retribution.

p.src: 44:17  Indeed, We tested the people of Pharaoh before them, when a noble messenger came to them,

ar: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ كَرِيمٌ
en: Indeed, We tested the people of Pharaoh before them, when a noble messenger came to them,
u.src: 44:17  Indeed, We tested the people of Pharaoh before them, when a noble messenger came to them,

p.src: 44:18  [saying], “Hand over to me the slaves of Allah[5]. I am indeed a trustworthy messenger to you,

ar: أَنْ أَدُّوٓا۟ إِلَىَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
en: [saying], “Hand over to me the slaves of Allah[5]. I am indeed a trustworthy messenger to you,
u.src: 44:18  [saying], “Hand over to me the slaves of Allah[5]. I am indeed a trustworthy messenger to you,

en: [5] i.e., the Children of Israel.

p.src: 44:19  and do not be arrogant towards Allah. I have certainly come to you with clear proof.

ar: وَأَن لَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
en: and do not be arrogant towards Allah. I have certainly come to you with clear proof.
u.src: 44:19  and do not be arrogant towards Allah. I have certainly come to you with clear proof.

p.src: 44:20  And I certainly seek refuge with my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me to death[6].

ar: وَإِنِّى عُذْتُ بِرَبِّى وَرَبِّكُمْ أَن تَرْجُمُونِ
en: And I certainly seek refuge with my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me to death[6].
u.src: 44:20  And I certainly seek refuge with my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me to death[6].

en: [6] Or assault me with your tongues.

p.src: 44:21  If you do not believe me, then leave me alone.”

ar: وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ لِى فَٱعْتَزِلُونِ
en: If you do not believe me, then leave me alone.”
u.src: 44:21  If you do not believe me, then leave me alone.”

p.src: 44:22  Then he called upon his Lord, “These are wicked people”.

ar: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌ مُّجْرِمُونَ
en: Then he called upon his Lord, “These are wicked people”.
u.src: 44:22  Then he called upon his Lord, “These are wicked people”.

p.src: 44:23  [Allah said], “Leave along with My slaves by night; you will surely be pursued.

ar: فَأَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى لَيْلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
en: [Allah said], “Leave along with My slaves by night; you will surely be pursued.
u.src: 44:23  [Allah said], “Leave along with My slaves by night; you will surely be pursued.

p.src: 44:24  And leave the sea parted[7]; for they are surely an army destined to drown.”

ar: وَٱتْرُكِ ٱلْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا ۖ إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌ مُّغْرَقُونَ
en: And leave the sea parted[7]; for they are surely an army destined to drown.”
u.src: 44:24  And leave the sea parted[7]; for they are surely an army destined to drown.”

en: [7] i.e., calm and still, in order that Pharaoh and his soldiers would follow you and be drowned.

p.src: 44:25  [Imagine] how many gardens and springs they left behind,

ar: كَمْ تَرَكُوا۟ مِن جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
en: [Imagine] how many gardens and springs they left behind,
u.src: 44:25  [Imagine] how many gardens and springs they left behind,

p.src: 44:26  and crops and splendid mansions,

ar: وَزُرُوعٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ
en: and crops and splendid mansions,
u.src: 44:26  and crops and splendid mansions,

p.src: 44:27  and luxuries they used to rejoice therein.

ar: وَنَعْمَةٍ كَانُوا۟ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهِينَ
en: and luxuries they used to rejoice therein.
u.src: 44:27  and luxuries they used to rejoice therein.

p.src: 44:28  So it was; and We made another people inherit all that.

ar: كَذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَأَوْرَثْنَـٰهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
en: So it was; and We made another people inherit all that.
u.src: 44:28  So it was; and We made another people inherit all that.

p.src: 44:29  Neither the heaven nor earth wept for them, nor were they given any respite.

ar: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنظَرِينَ
en: Neither the heaven nor earth wept for them, nor were they given any respite.
u.src: 44:29  Neither the heaven nor earth wept for them, nor were they given any respite.

p.src: 44:30  Thus did We save the Children of Israel from the humiliating punishment,

ar: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
en: Thus did We save the Children of Israel from the humiliating punishment,
u.src: 44:30  Thus did We save the Children of Israel from the humiliating punishment,

p.src: 44:31  from Pharaoh. He was indeed arrogant who transgressed all bounds.

ar: مِن فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيًا مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
en: from Pharaoh. He was indeed arrogant who transgressed all bounds.
u.src: 44:31  from Pharaoh. He was indeed arrogant who transgressed all bounds.

p.src: 44:32  We chose them[8] knowingly over all other peoples.

ar: وَلَقَدِ ٱخْتَرْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
en: We chose them[8] knowingly over all other peoples.
u.src: 44:32  We chose them[8] knowingly over all other peoples.

en: [8] We chose the Children of Israel over all other peoples of their time for their numerous prophets.

p.src: 44:33  And We gave them signs in which there was a clear test.

ar: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَـٰٓؤٌا۟ مُّبِينٌ
en: And We gave them signs in which there was a clear test.
u.src: 44:33  And We gave them signs in which there was a clear test.

p.src: 44:34  Indeed, these [Makkans] say,

ar: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ
en: Indeed, these [Makkans] say,
u.src: 44:34  Indeed, these [Makkans] say,

p.src: 44:35  “There is nothing after our first death, and we will not be resurrected,

ar: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ
en: “There is nothing after our first death, and we will not be resurrected,
u.src: 44:35  “There is nothing after our first death, and we will not be resurrected,

p.src: 44:36  then bring back our forefathers if you are truthful.”

ar: فَأْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
en: then bring back our forefathers if you are truthful.”
u.src: 44:36  then bring back our forefathers if you are truthful.”

p.src: 44:37  Are they better [in power] or the people of Tubba‘[9] and those who were before them? We destroyed them, for they were truly wicked[10].

ar: أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ
en: Are they better [in power] or the people of Tubba‘[9] and those who were before them? We destroyed them, for they were truly wicked[10].
u.src: 44:37  Are they better [in power] or the people of Tubba‘[9] and those who were before them? We destroyed them, for they were truly wicked[10].

en:
[9] i.e., the people of Sheba.
 [10] Tubba’ al-Himyari was a righteous Yemeni king of ancient times whose people persisted in disbelief and were destroyed; nonetheless, they were more powerful and superior to the pagans of Makkah.

p.src: 44:38  We have not created the heavens and earth and all that is between them for amusement.

ar: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَـٰعِبِينَ
en: We have not created the heavens and earth and all that is between them for amusement.
u.src: 44:38  We have not created the heavens and earth and all that is between them for amusement.

p.src: 44:39  We have not created them except for a true purpose, but most of them do not know.

ar: مَا خَلَقْنَـٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
en: We have not created them except for a true purpose, but most of them do not know.
u.src: 44:39  We have not created them except for a true purpose, but most of them do not know.

p.src: 44:40  Indeed, the Day of Judgment is the time appointed for them all,

ar: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ مِيقَـٰتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
en: Indeed, the Day of Judgment is the time appointed for them all,
u.src: 44:40  Indeed, the Day of Judgment is the time appointed for them all,

p.src: 44:41  the Day when no patron[11] will avail another in the least, nor will they be helped,

ar: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى مَوْلًى عَن مَّوْلًى شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
en: the Day when no patron[11] will avail another in the least, nor will they be helped,
u.src: 44:41  the Day when no patron[11] will avail another in the least, nor will they be helped,

en: [11] i.e., protector, close associate, kith and kin, etc.

p.src: 44:42  except those to whom Allah shows mercy. He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

ar: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
en: except those to whom Allah shows mercy. He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.
u.src: 44:42  except those to whom Allah shows mercy. He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

p.src: 44:43  Indeed, the tree of Zaqqūm

ar: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
en: Indeed, the tree of Zaqqūm
u.src: 44:43  Indeed, the tree of Zaqqūm

p.src: 44:44  will be the food of the sinful,

ar: طَعَامُ ٱلْأَثِيمِ
en: will be the food of the sinful,
u.src: 44:44  will be the food of the sinful,

p.src: 44:45  like molten metal that will boil in their bellies

ar: كَٱلْمُهْلِ يَغْلِى فِى ٱلْبُطُونِ
en: like molten metal that will boil in their bellies
u.src: 44:45  like molten metal that will boil in their bellies

p.src: 44:46  like the boiling of scalding water.

ar: كَغَلْىِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
en: like the boiling of scalding water.
u.src: 44:46  like the boiling of scalding water.

p.src: 44:47  [It will be said], “Seize him and drag him into the midst of the Blazing Fire.

ar: خُذُوهُ فَٱعْتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
en: [It will be said], “Seize him and drag him into the midst of the Blazing Fire.
u.src: 44:47  [It will be said], “Seize him and drag him into the midst of the Blazing Fire.

p.src: 44:48  Then pour over his head the torment of scalding water.”

ar: ثُمَّ صُبُّوا۟ فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِۦ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
en: Then pour over his head the torment of scalding water.”
u.src: 44:48  Then pour over his head the torment of scalding water.”

p.src: 44:49  “Taste this. You are surely the mighty and honorable![12]

ar: ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْكَرِيمُ
en: “Taste this. You are surely the mighty and honorable![12]
u.src: 44:49  “Taste this. You are surely the mighty and honorable![12]

en: [12] Abu Jahl, the chief of pagans in Makkah, replied to the warning of punishment in the Hereafter by saying, “How can I be punished when I am the mighty and honorable one!” So Allah killed him in the Battle of Badr and humiliated him, and revealed this verse. He will be taunted with these words in Hell as a reminder of his own words and additional torment.

p.src: 44:50  This is what you [all] used to doubt.”

ar: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمْتَرُونَ
en: This is what you [all] used to doubt.”
u.src: 44:50  This is what you [all] used to doubt.”

p.src: 44:51  Indeed, the righteous will be in a safe place,

ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍ
en: Indeed, the righteous will be in a safe place,
u.src: 44:51  Indeed, the righteous will be in a safe place,

p.src: 44:52  in gardens and springs,

ar: فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
en: in gardens and springs,
u.src: 44:52  in gardens and springs,

p.src: 44:53  wearing fine silk and heavy brocade, facing one another.

ar: يَلْبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٍ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ
en: wearing fine silk and heavy brocade, facing one another.
u.src: 44:53  wearing fine silk and heavy brocade, facing one another.

p.src: 44:54  So it will be, and We will marry them to maidens with gorgeous eyes.

ar: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَـٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ
en: So it will be, and We will marry them to maidens with gorgeous eyes.
u.src: 44:54  So it will be, and We will marry them to maidens with gorgeous eyes.

p.src: 44:55  They will call therein for every kind of fruit, safe and secure.

ar: يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَـٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ
en: They will call therein for every kind of fruit, safe and secure.
u.src: 44:55  They will call therein for every kind of fruit, safe and secure.

p.src: 44:56  They will not taste death therein except the first death, and He will protect them from the punishment of the Blazing Fire,

ar: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ إِلَّا ٱلْمَوْتَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ ۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
en: They will not taste death therein except the first death, and He will protect them from the punishment of the Blazing Fire,
u.src: 44:56  They will not taste death therein except the first death, and He will protect them from the punishment of the Blazing Fire,

p.src: 44:57  as a grace from your Lord. That is the supreme triumph.

ar: فَضْلًا مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
en: as a grace from your Lord. That is the supreme triumph.
u.src: 44:57  as a grace from your Lord. That is the supreme triumph.

p.src: 44:58  We have made this [Qur’an] easy in your own language, so that they may take heed.

ar: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَـٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
en: We have made this [Qur’an] easy in your own language, so that they may take heed.
u.src: 44:58  We have made this [Qur’an] easy in your own language, so that they may take heed.

p.src: 44:59  Then wait; they too are waiting.

ar: فَٱرْتَقِبْ إِنَّهُم مُّرْتَقِبُونَ
en: Then wait; they too are waiting.
u.src: 44:59  Then wait; they too are waiting.
